notes: «قال ابن عباد حدثنا مروان» names Marwan a second time: the same man written twice in succession is one link, written in its fuller form.
The dashed «- يعني ابن كيسان -» gloss is left out; «يزيد» is the name in the text.
«جميعا عن مروان» makes the first two names one level of co-transmitters.
